_comment: Copy to env.local.json (gitignored) and run: flutter run --dart-define-from-file=env.local.json
_rule: PUBLIC VALUES ONLY. Anyone can unzip the APK and read every value here. Provider API keys, the Supabase service-role key, OAuth client secrets, the Firebase Admin credential and server signing keys belong on the BFF. Never paste an RPC URL that contains ?api-key= — AppConfig drops it.
